name: B10-0142/2024 (ECR) – Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
title: Situation in Azerbaijan, violation of human rights and international law and relations with Armenia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking for action. It asks Azerbaijan to release people jailed for their political views, including Gubad Ibadoghlu and 23 Armenian prisoners. It asks the European Commission and the United Nations to investigate what happened to missing Armenian soldiers and to protect Armenian cultural sites in Nagorno-Karabakh. It also calls on Armenia and Azerbaijan to sign a peace deal.

- No law changes; Parliament asks Azerbaijan to free prisoners and protect Armenian heritage.
- Affects jailed activists, Armenian prisoners and displaced Armenians from Nagorno-Karabakh.
- Next: the EU Commission and United Nations are urged to act; peace talks should continue.
